rows.note: Use 回聲 as the everyday default for a literal echo or overlapping echoes.

example.english: When we spoke in the cave, the reverberation rang out several times.
example.traditional: 我哋喺山洞入面講一句，回聲響咗幾次。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 saan1 dung6 jap6 min6 gong2 jat1 geoi3 wui4 seng1 hoeng2 zo2 gei2 ci3

rows.note: Use 餘波 for lingering repercussions that continue after an event, especially in society or politics.

example.english: The reverberation of this controversy is still being felt in society.
example.traditional: 呢場風波嘅餘波仲喺社會上持續緊。
example.jyutping: ni1 coeng4 fung1 bo1 ge3 jyu4 bo1 zung6 hai2 se5 wui2 soeng6 ci4 zuk6 gan2

rows.note: Use 後續影響 when you mean the later effects of an event without emphasizing a lingering aftermath.

example.english: The reverberation of the new policy will only become clear after some time.
example.traditional: 新政策推出之後，佢嘅後續影響要過一段時間先睇得清。
example.jyutping: san1 zing3 caak3 teoi1 ceot1 zi1 hau6 keoi5 ge3 hau6 zuk6 jing2 hoeng2 jiu3 gwo3 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan1 sin1 tai2 dak1 cing1
